result: No detected forbidden source-boundary bypass; selectable tactical decisions with the retired burst slot hidden; UI-bound features remain external by design. Native APIs always Runtime.

scope.method: Recursive local include graph + forbidden API ownership checks + manual review of game-call, queue, patch and scheduling paths. Lexical assertions cannot prove all runtime behavior.

extended_test_fixes: Cooperative pending requests bypass display cadence
Round-end settles cooperative ACK with per-serial receipt ownership
Both planning mailboxes share one frame budget and per-channel share
fixes: Capture-time match identity and context expiry prevent loading/menu input reuse
Loading/menu/invalid-frame quarantine precedes feature initialization; no arbitrary warmup delay
All event backends share live simulationReady preflight; ordinary queue append rechecks after native clock callback
Bounded host startup diagnostics, without DLL file IO
Local native legality query AV boundary remains within Runtime ownership; no private ingress or command replay
Host initial/torn snapshots never replace authenticated state; fresh timestamps avoid false connection timeout
Automatic bounded host logging and callback/handshake evidence without consuming host work
Source time/frame preserved across planning and queueing; per-order expiration; fresh suffix replan preserves aircraft quotas
Cursor WM_SETCURSOR goes through host input manager without holding scheduler mutex

Only the message entry consumes host work; frame detours removed; Patch API permits only three 1.0.4 judgment sites, two 1.0.24 post-initialization drawing sites, two pre.12 C4 capability loads, two 1.0.20 sidebar CALLs and pre.3 camera clamp and experimental scroll entries; 1.0.34 uses one shared-control entry and two strict owner-query CALL adapters under the manager; current-player switching remains disabled
Recycled host PID cannot reuse a dead retained controller process handle
Host builds reject including the Runtime execution client
Partial rebuilds invalidate old verification markers; Windows build verifies PE outputs before success
permitted_exceptions: 1.0.34 retains manual other-player events and uses a shared House predicate with two owner-query adapters; it does not patch the native receiver, object Owner, or the sample anomaly at 6378E0. Current-player switching remains disabled at host and Runtime; normal automation remains own-only. C4 uses two capability-load sites (movement and charge placement), installed/restored as a group; native charge/timer/damage code remains in the game. This changes local simulation judgments and is not a netplay-safe claim. Two other experimental judgment features use three sites; render display uses exactly ShroudDraw/FogDraw post-initialization sites; defaults off. Render display and native aircraft waypoints are ordinary UI controls; network aircraft paths now use the ordinary event gateway without either aircraft patch; native aircraft patches are SP-only. Small-map clamp adds one manager-owned five-byte entry only when viewport bounds invert and the full remaining native body matches; existing foreign patches are preserved. Executable patch writes owned by the entry manager; stateful callbacks acquire a bound-thread Capture lease, while the control hot leaves only return a constant or compare CurrentPlayer. Explicit host polling feeds Runtime. Optional compatible ground-click suppression uses the existing common message boundary only, default off; no OutList rewriting

Opt-in shroud material replacement writes verified raw alpha planes only through the active Assist Runtime lease; same-process writable non-executable pages, original backup and conflict-aware restoration, no gameplay event or executable patch
Read-only game-side validation/resource reads under Runtime execution
Central transport supports verified construct/enqueue and original high-level backends
Local UI refresh fields/selection/cursor use guarded Runtime calls; not every operation is a network event

remaining.detail: Burst UI/settings are retired and the scheduler never calls burstControlTick, including with stale shared flags. Native Scatter/Move evasion events stay in Runtime. Five planning shares and actor arbitration. Native Scatter owns evasion destinations; pending/turning/moving jobs cannot be replaced by fresh shots. No timed restoration of old missions. No ability, rank, ROF or burst-index writes by automatic evasion.

Runtime-only native SelectWeapon/GetWeapon/IsCloseEnough produces complete per-source facts. Shared pure ranking prefers actual in-range targets; approach Move switches to empty-destination Attack. Fresh admission discards obsolete Move without mailbox blockage. No new hook or direct mission writes.
Runtime native virtual weapon/range queries; shared pure allocation on either side; fresh identity/token/range recheck and shared budget/nativeMission final submission. No new hook.
Runtime raw collection/native legality; matching selectable in Runtime or host; identity/token/capacity recheck and event/retry remain Runtime.
Runtime snapshot and cadence; pure candidate filtering selectable; pending observation/final legality/event stay Runtime.

remaining.feature: Smart unload/ejection deployment and target choice
remaining.detail: Shared pure unload_compute decision, Runtime collection/legality and source-stamped host batch; cancellation, identity checks, receipts and final native events stay Runtime.
Shared immutable process connection, independent task caches and source-stamped copies; not one cross-feature atomic world.

User-approved scope: statistics/reservation UI/overlays/minimap stay external; native selection/input/judgment stay Runtime. The retired BurstRefresh slot is hidden; remaining tactical decision families are selectable; external Z paths remain host planning.
